20. At 1523 hours, I met ADO CHOW Tsz-ho and ADO CHEUNG at the roundabout near Wang Tai House. I reported to ADO CHEUNG about the firefighting and an assistance call at Room 2701 of Wang Cheong House. I also reported to him about the contents of the Mayday message I heard through R/T at 1522 hours. I informed him that in response to the Mayday message, I formed 4 Emergency Response Teams (“ERT”) including the crew members of TP/MP and TP/HP to clear access to the interior of Wang Cheong House for carrying out the rescue operation for the distressed member(s). He tasked me to continue the Mayday operation.

21. At the roundabout near the front entrance of Wang Cheong House, PSTnO LIAO reported to me that the Mayday message sender was SFn HO of ST/LRU. On request from PSTnO LIAO, I instructed him to form the fifth ERT for clearing an access and carrying out the rescue operation for SFn HO.

[Question 9(d)]
